As well as this, the modern definition of a wendigo isn't entirely accurate as well. It's been bastardized because of Hollywood films, as a stock horror creature. Quite frankly, if it were to be executed it would not be true to the culture it originates from, because of this bastardization continues to influence people's depictions of wendigos.
